# GopherTrunk

> GopherTrunk is a pure-Go software-defined-radio (SDR) scanner engine that follows
> and decodes digital trunked-radio voice calls (P25, DMR, TETRA, NXDN, Motorola,
> EDACS, LTR, MPT 1327, dPMR, D-STAR, YSF) from RTL-SDR, HackRF, and Airspy hardware.
> The site also hosts a free, structured learning path that teaches radio and SDR
> fundamentals from beginner to expert.

## Getting started with GopherTrunk
- [What is GopherTrunk?]({{ '/getting-started.html' | absolute_url }}): conceptual overview of the scanner and its interfaces.
- [Get started]({{ '/getting-started-setup.html' | absolute_url }}): from a dongle to your first decoded call.
- [Hardware]({{ '/hardware.html' | absolute_url }}): supported SDR dongles.
- [Downloads]({{ '/downloads.html' | absolute_url }}): builds for Linux, macOS, and Windows.

## Police scanner buyer's guides & hardware
Consumer scanner hardware (Uniden, Whistler) compared honestly against a free SDR + GopherTrunk.
- [Best police scanners]({{ '/best-police-scanners/' | absolute_url }}): buyer's guide to every scanner worth owning, with an honest SDR comparison.
- [Police scanner vs GopherTrunk (SDR)]({{ '/police-scanner-vs-sdr/' | absolute_url }}): where dedicated hardware wins and where free software wins.
- [How police scanners work]({{ '/how-police-scanners-work/' | absolute_url }}): trunking, talkgroups, P25/DMR/NXDN in plain language.
- [Police scanner encryption explained]({{ '/police-scanner-encryption/' | absolute_url }}): why no scanner (or SDR) can decode AES, and what stays open.
- [Is a police scanner legal?]({{ '/police-scanner-legal/' | absolute_url }}): federal and state law on owning and using a scanner.
- [Scanner frequencies by service]({{ '/scanner-frequencies/' | absolute_url }}): police, fire, EMS, aviation, marine, and railroad band plans.
- [How to program a police scanner]({{ '/how-to-program-a-police-scanner/' | absolute_url }}): zip-code, manual, and software programming.
- [Best scanner antennas]({{ '/best-scanner-antenna/' | absolute_url }}): indoor, outdoor, and mobile antennas that fix weak reception.
- [Digital vs analog scanners]({{ '/digital-vs-analog-scanner/' | absolute_url }}): what you can still hear on an analog radio in 2026.
- [P25 scanners]({{ '/p25-scanner/' | absolute_url }}): what Phase I/II and simulcast mean for buyers.
